physicalNotes: Radius 1.49 +/- 0.19 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-17 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 1,036,593 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
